name: get_tables_information
description: Get database schema metadata including table structures, columns, data types, and relationships for the video game sales PostgreSQL database. Call this tool first to understand what data is available before writing SQL queries.

name: execute_sql_query
description: Execute a read-only SQL query against the video game sales PostgreSQL database. The database contains 64,016 video game titles with sales data across regions (NA, Japan, EU, rest of world), critic scores, genres, consoles, publishers, and developers from 1971 to 2024.

sql_query.description: The SQL query to execute. Must be read-only (SELECT only). Use the schema from get_tables_information to write correct queries.

description.description: A clear description of what this query analyzes or retrieves from the video game sales data.
